[[File:ON-skill-High Hrothgar Festival Mints.jpg|thumb|right|Very Cold]]'''High Hrothgar Festival Mints''' can be purchased from [[ON:Traveling Festival Merchants|Traveling Festival Merchants]] during the [[ON:New Life Festival|New Life Festival]] for {{ESO Price|22}}. They have no practical benefit, but momentarily turn your character's skin to ice. Eating one bestows the '''Very Cold''' status effect, which snares you, reducing your movement speed.
